items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: He plays with Tommy Richland last time I heard of him.

ctx.x: He's your nephew? Yeah. What does he play like?

He's like, I know what he can play. They tell me he's good, but I know what he can play. He plays with Tommy Richland last time I heard of him. Tommy Richland. He's a rock and roll player. But I think he plays minor jazz too. Yeah. I never did him. You never taught him anything, huh?
No. Well, of all the bands you played with, Albert, which one did you enjoy playing with the most? Did you have a special favorite? The band you thought was really good? No, I enjoyed all of them.
